sys_atf_test.name: DDI happy path: provision a DDI-backed subnet
sys_atf_test.description: End-to-end happy path in test_mode: a requester orders the subnet, an approver approves (SoD), the Flow allocates + registers + gates + reconciles, and the request closes complete. Asserts each stage.

sys_atf_step.description: Impersonate the requester (a non-admin test user, e.g. ddi.requester) so SoD is real.

sys_atf_step.step_config_title: Service Catalog - Open a Catalog Item
Service Catalog - Set Catalog Item Variable Values
sys_atf_step.description: Fill the form with the Azure exemplar values (mirrors terraform.tfvars.example).
sys_atf_step.inputs: target_platform = Microsoft Azure (ALZ) location = eastus hub_vnet_id = /subscriptions/0000.../virtualNetworks/vnet-hub-conn ddi_subnet_address_prefix= 10.10.8.0/27 environment = dev deployment_model = grid host_fqdn = app-gw01.corp.example key_vault_id = /subscriptions/0000.../vaults/kv-ddi-conn mgmt_source_cidrs = 10.10.0.0/24 dns_client_cidrs = 10.16.0.0/12 business_justification = ATF happy-path test

sys_atf_step.step_config_title: Service Catalog - Submit a Catalog Item (Order Now)
sys_atf_step.description: Order it; ATF captures the generated Requested Item (RITM). Save the RITM sys_id as step output for later steps.
Switch to the approver (a DIFFERENT user, ddi.approver) — this is what makes the SoD gate meaningful (requester != approver).
Approve the pending approval for the RITM (ATF has no built-in "approve" step). Assert requester != current approver first.
Assert the Flow ran to completion in test_mode: allocated IP recorded and gate passed. (The provisioning Flow runs async — see README for the wait pattern; here we assert the recorded results.)

OPTIONAL — assert a cmdb_ci_ip_network CI exists for the subnet correlated by servicenow_sys_id. In test_mode the Service Graph Connector import does not run, so either seed a CI as a test fixture or skip this assertion. See README.
sys_atf_step.inputs: table = cmdb_ci_ip_network conditions = name=10.10.8.0/27 assert = at least 1 record (requires SGC test double or a seeded fixture)

sys_atf_step.description: Assert the request item closed complete.
